blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

items.t: It carries a "Homes for sale in Otter District / Live MLS® listings, updated daily" section; no feed-count header was visible in the page text read, and the cards read under Additional Details (snapshot only: eight cards, all labelled Otter District, Status: Active — on 244 Street, 30 Avenue, 21b Avenue, 248 Street, 240 Street and Fraser Highway) are a snapshot, not a statistic. The guide page's total feed count and the exact MLS feed filter behind it: UNVERIFIED.

Identity, following the guide page: Otter District is the rural southeast corner of the Township of Langley, mostly south of Fraser Highway, between Campbell Valley and Aldergrove, running down to 0 Avenue at the U.S. border, with its old centre at the farm crossroads of 248 Street and Fraser Highway. Board geography: "Otter District" is one of eleven Langley sub-areas in the SnapStats data; "Langley" the board community combines the Township of Langley and the City of Langley, and this sub-area sits entirely on the Township side.

The Condos & Townhomes 0/0 combination is shared by three Langley sub-areas (Campbell Valley, County Line Glen Valley and Otter District), and Otter District and Campbell Valley are the two sub-areas with zero sales in BOTH splits. An Otter District median is UNVERIFIED — SnapStats publishes medians at community level only.

Where the condo stock concentrates: there is none to concentrate. The board counted zero attached listings in the sub-area in September 2026; the feed's attached-form product is pad-rental park homes, and the rest of the feed is freehold acreages. The structural reason, in one line: much of this district is Agricultural Land Reserve country, and ALR residences cannot be stratified.

Poppy Secondary, 23752 52 Ave, Langley. The guide page names the first three as the schools near Otter District; a school's presence nearby is not a catchment assignment. Poppy Secondary, no middle school shown) belongs to that address only and must not be extended to Otter District homes.

items.t: The ALR frame — the governing fact for much of this district: ALR land may generally have no more than one residence per parcel unless it qualifies for an additional residence, and local governments may further regulate or restrict residences through zoning. The principal residence maximum is a total floor area of 500 m²; a secondary suite is permitted only when it is entirely contained within the principal residence (a separate or detached dwelling is not a secondary suite) and local bylaws permit it; and one additional detached residence is permitted without an ALC application at up to 90 m² on properties of 40 ha or less, or up to 186 m² on properties over 40 ha, subject to local bylaws. ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)). Parcel-level ALR status: UNVERIFIED for any specific property — confirmed on the ALC's ALR maps, not from the sub-area name.

Township zoning and the coach house: rural homes in this part of the Township sit under Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500, and the feed's own listings name RU-2 zoning for acreage parcels; zone assignments for a specific parcel come from the bylaw Map Schedules through the Township's GeoSource. In Bylaw 2500, s. 102, a "coach house" is an accessory dwelling unit located only within the second storey of a detached garage — it is a fee-simple second unit under the zoning bylaw, never strata — and no coach-house size cap appears in s. The Township caps a secondary suite at 120 m² maximum gross floor area (Bylaw No. 2500, s. 102 definition).

SSMUH — Township Bylaw 6020, and why it mostly does not reach this district: the bylaw amendments adopted November 18, 2024 (Bylaw 6020) permit SSMUH in residential zones previously restricted to single-family or duplex use, but eligibility requires the property to be within the Urban Containment Boundary, connected to both municipal water and sewer, not larger than 4,050 m² and not in a zone with a minimum lot size larger than 4,050 m²; properties that do not meet those criteria are instead eligible for one residential unit plus one secondary suite or accessory dwelling unit, depending on zoning — the frame most rural Otter acreages fall under. There is NO 6-plex / 6-unit tier in the Township.

Pad rent (the park): pad rent at Langley Grove Estates is governed by the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act: the rent increase limit for manufactured home site tenancies is 2.3% plus a proportional amount for 2026 and 2.2% plus a proportional amount for 2027.

items.t: (1) The card for the Langley Grove Estates unit at 52 24330 Fraser Highway carries a header price that conflicts with the different price stated at the end of its own listing text — the two prices in the same card do not match. (2) A 30 Avenue card advertises an open house for Sunday, October 25, 2026 — a date that had already passed by the November 1, 2026 reading while the card still showed Status: Active, so the open-house text is stale.

The guide places North Otter Elementary's catchment on both sides of Fraser Highway "on the SD35 map" and names Aldergrove Community Secondary as the secondary school, while the recorded locator sample for 4452 256 Street returned North Otter Elementary and D.W. Poppy Secondary.

A block of guide-page claims is site copy only. Col. William Otter; settler John William Best), the Otter Co-op history (Farmers' Institute formed 1922, store in 1946, became the Otter Co-op in 1979), Saint Alban's church moved in 1926, Otter Park's amenities and dawn-to-dusk hours, Fire Hall 7 – Otter at 3876 248 Street, the Bertrand Creek / Aldergrove aquifer notes, the Rural Plan (Bylaw No. 3250) Agro-Service Centre description, and the Highway 1 / 264 Street diverging-diamond rebuild with completion expected in 2027.
Zero is a statistic here, not a gap in the research.
The neighbouring district is not a proxy.

The park carries two civic addresses in the feeds. Langley Grove Estates appears at 3665 244 Street and at 24330 Fraser Highway in listing cards — the same park under both addresses, so a search run under only one address understates the park's shelf.

Two dwellings on a listing does not mean two legal dwellings. The feed leads with multi-generational product — properties with two homes in their listing text — while the ALR frame permits at most one additional detached residence of 90 m² (40 ha or less) or 186 m² (over 40 ha) without an ALC application. The approvals history is the diligence, not the listing text.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Otter District Townhomes

items.t: Fee-simple contrast — the district's acreages ARE the fee-simple case: A fee-simple property carries NO strata, NO Form B, NO strata fees — title, Township rules and registered covenants only.

ALR frame — the governing fact for much of this district: on ALR land, one principal residence is permitted without an ALC application at a maximum total floor area of 500 m² (no more than 1,000 m² of fill); a secondary suite is permitted only when entirely contained within the principal residence (a separate or detached dwelling is not a secondary suite) and local bylaws permit it; and one additional detached residence is permitted at up to 90 m² on properties of 40 ha or less, or up to 186 m² on properties over 40 ha, subject to local bylaws. ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)). Two first-page listings state ALR status in their own text (the South Otter Schoolhouse property "within the ALR"; a 5.45-acre parcel "located in the ALR and zoned RU-2") — listing copy for those parcels only, not a district-wide designation.

SSMUH (Township standing correction): Zoning Bylaw 6020, adopted November 18, 2024 — NO 6-plex tier exists in it. Township eligibility for SSMUH requires the property to be within the Urban Containment Boundary, connected to both municipal water and sewer, not larger than 4,050 m² and not in a zone with a minimum lot size larger than 4,050 m²; properties that do not meet those criteria are instead eligible for one residential unit plus one secondary suite or accessory dwelling unit, depending on zoning — the frame most rural Otter acreages will fall under. Do not import the urban SSMUH numbers onto an acreage.

: in Zoning Bylaw No. 2500, s. 102, a "coach house" is a fee-simple second unit — an accessory dwelling unit located only within the second storey of a detached garage; never strata, never a townhouse complex. A ground-floor detached suite is a different accessory unit with different rules. Flagged, resolved nowhere (live Township conflict): s. No coach-house size cap appears in s.

Plans (Township standing frame): the Willoughby Community Plan originates as Bylaw 1836 (1979), now Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200 (adopted Dec 1, 2025); Willoughby Plan Update Bylaws 6201/6202/6203 had first/second reading May 25, 2026 ONLY, with a Public Hearing directed for June 15, 2026 — adoption/repeal claims are UNVERIFIED, and any page claiming the Plan was "replaced" by those bylaws is in error.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Otter District

items.t: ALR block (the governing frame for much of this district — parcel status still parcel-specific): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)) — creating a bare-land strata on ALR land is itself a subdivision needing the same permission. ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m² (no more than 1,000 m² of fill), suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha), where municipal bylaws also permit it. Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

Strata block (bare-land strata parcels, if met outside the ALR): Form B within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss.123.1/123.2 + May 1, 2023 exemptions). A fee-simple lot carries none of this.

blocks.text: Good to know about Otter District

items.t: Zero is a real number here (SnapStats, Sep 2026).

A property already carrying two dwellings needs its approvals history checked (ALC frame). The feed's first page leads with multi-dwelling acreages; on ALR land the permitted frame is one principal (≤500 m²), a suite only inside it, and at most one additional residence of 90 m² / 186 m² without an ALC application — existing second dwellings are a diligence question, not an assumption.

Farm class is three tiers, not one (BC Assessment). $2,500 of farm income on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31 — a flat "$2,500+" line understates the test for small and large parcels alike.
Gaps carried as UNVERIFIED: parcel-level ALR and flood status, transit, in-district facilities, park rules, and catchments.

faq.q: What is a coach house in Langley Township?
faq.a: Under Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500, s.102, a coach house is an accessory dwelling unit located only within the second storey of a detached garage — the definition settled in this program's rules-gaps pass (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/rules-gaps-2026-11-01.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Otter District than in June?
faq.a: In Otter District, listings of houses was 3 in June and 2 in September, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall.

faq.q: How big is Otter District compared with the rest of Langley?
faq.a: In September 2026, Otter District held 0.4% of the 449 houses listed in Langley.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Otter District from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 1 houses sold in Otter District over those 4 months.

faq.q: Are there any condos in Otter District?
faq.a: The attached-form product the feed shows is manufactured homes in one pad-rental park, Langley Grove Estates.

faq.q: Can I build a second house on an Otter District acreage in the ALR?
faq.a: Within the ALC frame, one additional detached residence is permitted without an ALC application at up to 90 m² on a property of 40 ha or less, or up to 186 m² on a property over 40 ha, subject to Township bylaws; the principal residence itself is capped at 500 m², and a secondary suite must be entirely inside the principal residence (and within the Township's 120 m² suite cap).

faq.q: Can I use the urban SSMUH numbers on an Otter acreage?
faq.a: No. Township eligibility for 3–4 units under Bylaw 6020 requires Urban Containment Boundary location, municipal water and sewer, and a lot no larger than 4,050 m², and there is no 6-unit tier in the Township at all; a rural Otter lot that fails those tests falls to one unit plus a suite or accessory unit depending on zoning.

faq.q: Is Langley Grove Estates a condo complex?
faq.a: No — it is a manufactured-home park at 3665 244 Street (also carded at 24330 Fraser Highway).

faq.q: Can I build a second house on an Otter District acreage in the ALR?
faq.a: Within the ALC frame, one additional detached residence is permitted without an ALC application at up to 90 m² on a property of 40 ha or less, or up to 186 m² on a property over 40 ha, provided there is only one existing residence when construction begins and Township bylaws allow it; the principal residence itself is capped at 500 m², and a secondary suite must be entirely inside the principal residence.

faq.q: Can I strata-title the second home later?
faq.a: Not on ALR land within the ALC frame: ALR residences cannot be stratified — a strata plan deposit is a subdivision (SPA s. 239) and subdivision of agricultural land is prohibited unless the Commission permits it (ALCA s. 21(1); ALC Bulletin 09 s.

faq.q: Is Langley Grove Estates a 55+ park, or strata townhouses?
Can I put 3–4 SSMUH units on an Otter acreage?
faq.a: Almost never on this ground: Township SSMUH eligibility requires Urban Containment Boundary location, municipal water and sewer, and a lot no larger than 4,050 m².
